origine_fr: 户 qui abrite l'oiseau 隹 : 户 donnait le son. C'était d'abord un oiseau migrateur qui annonce les travaux des champs. Emprunté pour « louer les services », 雇 veut dire embaucher.
origine_en: 户 sheltering the bird 隹: 户 gave the sound. It was first a migratory bird that heralds the farming seasons. Borrowed for “to hire someone's services”, 雇 means to employ.

phrase.pinyin: Gōngsī jiěgù le shí gè yuángōng.
phrase.en: The company laid off ten employees.
